description: This file defines a Bottom Sheet UI component (RecipeDetailBottomSheet) for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including options to favorite, edit, or delete the recipe. It manages UI updates based on ViewModel data and handles user interactions.

classes.name: RecipeDetailBottomSheet
classes.description: A BottomSheetDialogFragment that displays detailed information about a recipe and provides actions for favoriting, editing, or deleting the recipe.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of RecipeDetailBottomSheet for a specific recipe ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves the recipe ID from arguments, and loads the recipe data into the ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the bottom sheet UI.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI element references, observes ViewModel data for recipe details, and attaches click listeners for user actions.
